review.why: Runs one subagent per independent problem, each with a focused brief and no inherited history, then reviews and integrates the results.
review.summary: Use when there are several unrelated failures or subsystems with no shared state. The steps are to group problems by domain, give each agent a specific scope, goal, constraints and expected output, dispatch all in one response so they run concurrently, then read each summary, check for conflicts and run the full tests. A decision diagram says when not to use it.
strengths: Clear test for independence before splitting work
Agents get only the context they need, which keeps the coordinator's context free
Always verifies fixes do not conflict and runs the full suite
cautions: Needs a harness with parallel subagents
No handling of failed or timed-out agents
